name: Efficient Ironman
description: A deterministic, account-adaptive path through the current Wiki Ironman quest order, with explicit training milestones and curated early routing.

sources.title: OSRS Wiki — Optimal quest guide/Ironman
sources.notes: Quest/action ordering and training milestone facts. IronPath wording is original and concise.

sources.title: BRUHsailer
sources.notes: Reviewed for modern efficiency concepts only; no guide prose is bundled.

chapters.name: Account Foundations
chapters.description: Secure early cash, transport, and quest-reward combat levels.

chapters.name: Early Travel & Questing
chapters.description: Batch Varrock, Falador, Karamja, and western travel while starting long collections.

chapters.name: Core Skills & Fairy Rings
chapters.description: Build the skill floor and unlock the transport network that compresses every later chapter.

chapters.name: Regional Unlocks
chapters.description: Open Fossil Island, Morytania, Kourend, and the first repeatable account systems.

chapters.name: RFD & Fremennik
chapters.description: Advance Recipe for Disaster and the Fremennik quest chains toward durable combat rewards.

chapters.name: Combat & Spellbooks
chapters.description: Unlock Iban's staff, Ancient Magicks, and broader midgame combat access.

chapters.name: Midgame Systems & Kingdom
chapters.description: Establish Slayer, diaries, kingdom, and the supporting skill economy.

chapters.name: Barrows Gloves & Piety
chapters.description: Convert accumulated quest requirements into the first major all-style combat baseline.

chapters.name: Varlamore & Midgame Gear
chapters.description: Use modern Varlamore unlocks and Moons equipment as flexible progression branches.

chapters.name: Sailing & Slayer Branches
chapters.description: Raise modern traversal and combat skills without committing to one mandatory gear prison.

chapters.name: Grandmaster Foundations
chapters.description: Complete the quest lines that open raids, Prifddinas, Darkmeyer, and late PvM.

chapters.name: Quest Cape & Late Unlocks
chapters.description: Finish the remaining grandmaster and current-release quest requirements.
